title: Configure provider discounts for external model spend
body:
Unity Gateway estimates external model spend using each provider's published list prices. If your organization has negotiated different pricing with a provider, you can now configure a **price multiplier** on the model provider service so that spend estimates reflect those rates.

Price multipliers only apply to external models accessed through model provider services, not Databricks-hosted partner models.

See [Configure a price multiplier](/aws/en/ai-gateway/create-model-provider-services#configure-a-price-multiplier).
